status: PROPOSED (P3-2 Fresh Audit). Machine-testable: tools/original_pizza_p3_2_fact_display_audit.mjs checks every `check` id against current main; the P3-2 implementation must turn the same rows into Vitest cases.
authority: src/logic/discovery/hint5Ladder.ts: hint5Presentation / hint5Ownership (the only fact authority the memo reads)

memoInput.note: The memo is a pure function of exactly these inputs and nothing else. There is no input for a recipe, a description, a P2 feedback, a Trial Notebook entry, a matcher result, a candidate list, a technique ledger or a Pitz balance.
fields: cardState: RecipeDiscoveryState of the Dex card
presentation: Hint5Presentation | null  (hint5Presentation(...) for this card's own recipe; null = not a ladder target)
memoInput.projection: only presentation.board, presentation.legacyKnownIngredientIds and presentation.completeText are read; presentation.next, presentation.pitzBalance and presentation.onboarding (except as a gate) are never read

gates.rule: cardState !== DISCOVERABLE -> no memo (DISCOVERED keeps the formal recipe card; KNOWN_BUT_MISSING_MATERIAL and UNKNOWN are out of Phase 1)
presentation === null (not a ladder target, fail closed) -> no memo
presentation.onboarding (Dex-0 Margherita, session-only reveal, nothing persisted) -> no memo

invariants.statement: the memo exists only for DISCOVERABLE
no memo with the Hint 5.0 flag off (the rollback path shows none)
no memo for a non-ladder target
no memo for the Dex-0 onboarding

for every production recipe and every prefix of the ladder (0..n rungs bought through the real authority), the fixed rows are KNOWN exactly for the completed fixed rungs, with exactly the ladder's own subject ids, and UNKNOWN rows carry no id
SUB_CLASS rows appear only after STRUCTURE is completed, only for completed rungs, only as family views, in ladder order; a forged cls: record without h5:structure yields none
completeText is present iff every rung is completed
a legacy ing: name appears only in legacyKnownIngredientIds, completes no rung, and never alters the pre-purchase view
the memo projection (board + legacyKnownIngredientIds + completeText) contains no next offer, no price, no free text line

the serialised projection contains no ingredient id of a rung that is not completed (other than an owned legacy name), no sub-topping id (other than an owned legacy name), no recipe id, name or description, and no cls: / h5: / ing: / meta: string
with nothing bought (and discoveredCount >= 1), the projection is byte-identical for every production recipe
two recipes at the same purchase prefix differ only in the contents of completed rungs: replacing a recipe's unbought content never changes the projection
a malformed, hostile or future ledger (non-array, proto keys, unknown kinds, numbers) never throws and never adds a row
(implementation gate, P3-2) the memo module imports only hint5 types / the presentation and the card-state type: no P2, no Trial Notebook, no matcher, no recipe data, no technique module
